outcome: Composite maternal morbidity (severe postpartum hemorrhage, hysterectomy, transfusion, ICU admission, use of ≥2 uterotonic medications, maternal death)
finding: Induction of labor in twin pregnancies was associated with increased maternal morbidity compared to planned cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Labor induction in twin pregnancies was associated with increased maternal morbidity compared to planned cesarean delivery.
